rationale.conceptual: The method is an established multi-step first-principles approach (GGA-PBE, phonon Boltzmann transport, Voigt-Reuss-Hill averaging) that requires careful implementation but no novel algorithm derivation. Non-trivial math and several interacting components need to be correctly translated into code.
rationale.execution: The pipeline comprises at least 7 sequential stages (geometry relaxation, harmonic IFCs, anharmonic IFCs, ShengBTE run, elastic constants, moduli derivation, Raman frequencies) with dependencies across three open-source tools (Quantum ESPRESSO, Phonopy, ShengBTE). Orchestration is fragile and multi-tool, with several load-bearing handoffs.

difficulty.reasoning: The paper presents a standard first-principles workflow (DFT relaxation, phonon IFCs, PBTE solver) to compute thermal conductivity, elastic constants, and Raman frequencies. The conceptual method is established but non-trivial to implement correctly; the execution pipeline involves multiple fragile tool chains (QE, Phonopy, ShengBTE, Phonopy-Spectroscopy), making it moderately high on execution difficulty.

compute_estimate.reasoning: DFT supercell of 192 atoms with many displacement calculations and a PBTE solution on a 17×17×17 q-grid is CPU-intensive, requiring moderate RAM (~64GB) and negligible input data.
